theme.theme_name: Centaur rogue — deep sea teal and brass

short_rest.msg:
Spend Hit Dice (d8 + CON +2) to recover HP.
Rogue has no short-rest resources at level 1.

rest: Long Rest: Full HP, half Hit Dice restored (1 of 1)
No class resources to recharge yet — Cunning Action arrives at level 2

bonus: Charge — move 30 ft straight, hit in melee, then a free hoof attack
Nick (off-hand dagger, part of the Attack action)

reminders: Sneak Attack 1d6 — once per turn, with a Finesse or Ranged weapon, and you need advantage or an ally within 5 ft of the target.
Charge (Centaur): move 30 ft straight at a target, hit it in melee, then take a bonus action hoof attack — 1d6+3.
Hooves replace your normal unarmed strike: 1d6 + STR bludgeoning.
Vex on both swords and bow: a hit gives you advantage on your next attack against that target — which also turns on Sneak Attack.
Speed 40 ft, but Equine Build makes any hands-and-feet climb cost 4 extra feet per foot. Look for stairs.
Expertise: Stealth +8 and Intimidation +5. Cunning Action does not arrive until level 2 — hiding still costs your action.

features.title: 🐎 Species — Centaur (Fey)
bullets: Charge — 30 ft straight + melee hit → bonus-action hoof attack
Equine Build — carry as one size larger; climbs cost 4 extra ft per ft

features.title: ⚓ Background — Sailor
bullets: Ship's Passage — you can usually find a berth for the party

features.title: ✨ Origin Feat
bullets: Savage Attacker — once per turn, reroll a weapon's damage dice and keep either
